I've completed the three scoped fixes and pushed them directly to PR #563's branch:

1. **OS.yaml index registration** — added `ai-os/MIGRATION_DRIFT_AUDIT_2026-07-26.yaml` to `ai-os/OS.yaml`'s `health_and_compliance` index. Verified locally that this specific fix works (confirmed the file drops out of the "missing" list).
2. **Stale migration schema refs** — corrected `drizzle/0140*.sql` and `drizzle/0199*.sql` to target `platform.dynamic_chains` (matching migration 0245's real relocation, confirmed by reading it) instead of `compliance.dynamic_chains`, and `drizzle/0253*.sql`'s bare `ai_provider` to `compliance.ai_provider`. Grep-verified clean.
3. **PROGRESS.md stale checkbox** — fixed on PR #563's own branch.

One thing worth flagging: while verifying, I found the "Metadata Index Coverage Check" has a much bigger pre-existing problem — 56 unrelated `ai-os/` files were never indexed. I confirmed via a worktree at PR #563's merge-base and via `gh run view` on main's own latest CI run that this is **already failing on main HEAD right now**, unrelated to this PR. I deliberately didn't bulk-register those 56 files with guessed descriptions (this repo's governance docs are evidence-researched, not guessed) — flagged it in PROGRESS.md and ACTIVE-CLAIMS instead, recommending a dedicated follow-up task. So `gh pr checks 563` will likely still show that job red, but for that separate reason, not the one this task was asked to fix.

No live database changes were made — this was all repo-file-only, per the task's constraints. PR #563 is **not merged** and is held for your explicit sign-off, per the task's own instruction. I have a background monitor watching CI checks on the PR and will report back once they resolve.
